description: This file defines the TreeHash class which implements the HashInterface for generating a tree hash from streamed data, specific to Amazon Glacier's requirements.

classes.name: TreeHash
classes.description: A class that creates a tree hash from streamed data, used in Amazon Glacier for integrity verification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TreeHash with a specified hashing algorithm, defaulting to SHA-256.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Feeds additional data into the hash, buffering and creating checksums for chunks over 1MB.

methods.name: addChecksum
methods.description: Adds a precomputed checksum directly to the tree hash, bypassing the buffering step.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Completes the tree hash calculation, processing remaining data and checksums to derive the final root hash.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the TreeHash object to its initial state, clearing all data and checksums.
